correctness.rationale: The source supplies exactly four \([28,2,21]_4\) seed multiplicity vectors and a one-to-one correspondence with the four infinite \([5s+3,2,4s+1]_4\) classes for \(s\ge6\). The five projective columns have zero total Hermitian Gram contribution, so adding one full projective line preserves LCD nonsingularity and raises length by \(5\) and every nonzero codeword weight by \(4\). For any dimension-two projective-multiplicity code, a monomial automorphism is determined by a lift of a multiplicity-preserving projective transformation together with permutations inside equal projective-column blocks. Since the scalar kernel of \(\operatorname{GL}(2,4)\to\operatorname{PGL}(2,4)\) has order \(3\), the group order is \(3\prod m_i!\) times the color stabilizer. Exact enumeration of all \(180\) invertible matrices verifies the projective group has \(60\) actions and the four stabilizer orders are \(2,1,3,2\), giving the claimed formulas.
